name: Klubbrabatten
description: Klubbrabatten lets Claude search our live public discount catalog across Sweden. Find current offers by merchant, category or location, see the exact discount, branded coupon image, number of included coupons and eligible stores, and estimate potential savings before a purchase. The connector is public and read-only: it cannot redeem coupons, access accounts or change data. An active Klubbrabatten booklet is required to redeem a coupon securely in the app.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Klubbrabatten to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Klubbrabatten to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.klubbrabatten.se/functions/v1/ai-discovery.

_published_faq.name: Is Klubbrabatten MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Klubbrabatten scores 93/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Klubbrabatten MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Klubbrabatten provides these MCP tools: estimate_savings and find_discounts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Klubbrabatten?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Klubbrabatten in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Klubbrabatten does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Klubbrabatten is developed by Klubbrabatten AB. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
